map.GRBAS量表是日本嗓音医学学会制定的嗓音听感知评估标准，由评估者对嗓音的五个维: The GRBAS scale is an auditory-perceptual voice assessment standard set by the Japan Society of Logopedics and Phoniatrics, in which the rater scores five voice dimensions from 0 to 3.
map.GRBAS 嗓音总分 = 总嘶哑度 G + 粗糙 R + 气息 B + 无力 A: GRBAS voice total = overall grade G + roughness R + breathiness B + asthenia A + strain S (0 to 3 each), out of 15; 0 is normal, up to 3 mild, up to 7 moderate and above 7 severe abnormality.
map.嗓音异常的总体程度: The overall degree of voice abnormality
map.嗓音中不规则波动的心理声学印象（如嘎啦声、粗糙声）: The psychoacoustic impression of irregular voice fluctuation, such as a raspy or rough quality
map.嗓音中气流泄漏的心理声学印象（如沙沙声、气声）: The psychoacoustic impression of air escape in the voice, such as a hissing or breathy quality
map.嗓音中无力感/虚弱感的心理声学印象: The psychoacoustic impression of weakness or frailty in the voice
map.嗓音中过度用力/紧张感的心理声学印象: The psychoacoustic impression of excessive effort or tension in the voice
map.GRBAS评分需由有经验的嗓音评估者通过听觉感知进行。建议使用标准化语音样本（持: GRBAS scoring must be done by an experienced voice rater through auditory perception. A standardised speech sample (a sustained /a/ vowel plus reading a short passage) is recommended. The total runs from 0 to 15, with the G score as the main reference, while the sub-items reveal the characteristic features of the voice disorder.
map.声带息肉/小结嗓音分级。: Grading the voice in vocal fold polyps or nodules.
map.G2 R2 B1 A0 S0，提示中度粗糙伴轻度气息声，符合声带肿物/闭合不全，: G2 R2 B1 A0 S0 indicates moderate roughness with mild breathiness, consistent with a vocal fold mass or incomplete closure, so laryngoscopy is recommended.
map.GRBAS 与声学分析关系？: How does GRBAS relate to acoustic analysis?
map.GRBAS 为主观听感分级，声学（Jitter/Shimmer/HNR）为客观参: GRBAS is a subjective perceptual grade and acoustics (jitter, shimmer, HNR) give objective parameters; the two complement each other and improve reliability.
map.由言语治疗师/耳鼻喉医师经培训后判定，多例取均值可减少偏倚。: A trained speech therapist or ENT physician makes the judgement, and averaging several raters reduces bias.
